comment: The published wire layout of OutWit.Controller.AI.Corpus.Model: the Model package version and the MemoryPack member count of every DTO. A member appended to a DTO is a new Model version - bump <Version> in the Model csproj, publish it, and only then let the controller depend on it (the server restores the Model from the feed as a lib next to the module's copy; the lib wins). Update this file in the same commit as the csproj.
